list.title: Purchase orders
list.description: Orders placed with your suppliers and what is still on order.

empty.title: No purchase orders
empty.description: Create a purchase order to order stock from a supplier.

actions.confirmDescription: Confirming makes the ordered quantities show as on order. A confirmed order cannot be edited.
actions.closeDescription: Closing stops the remaining unshipped quantity from being expected. Give a reason.
actions.cancelDescription: Cancelling releases the on-order quantity. This only works before anything has shipped.
actions.deleteDescription: This permanently deletes the draft purchase order.

form.title: New purchase order
form.description: Order stock from a supplier. Save as a draft, then confirm when it is final.
form.invalidMoney: Prices must be plain numbers with the currency's decimals
form.invalidRate: Rates are percentages from 0 to 100 with up to two decimals
form.rateConflict: Use either a discount % or a discount amount on a line
